name: 4-FEC
summary: 4-Fluoroethcathinone (also known as 4-FEC) is a stimulant of the cathinone class and structural analog of flephedrone (4-fluoromethcathinone) that has been sold as designer drug.

uses.text: 4-Fluoroethcathinone (also known as 4-FEC) is a stimulant of the cathinone class and structural analog of flephedrone (4-fluoromethcathinone) that has been sold as designer drug.

pharmacology.en: Little research has been published on it. Like its close relative flephedrone, it is thought to act on the transporters for dopamine, noradrenaline and serotonin, raising the levels of these brain chemicals.
pharmacology.zh: 相關研究很少。一般認為它和近親氟甲基卡西酮一樣，作用於多巴胺、正腎上腺素與血清素的轉運體，使這些腦內化學物質的濃度升高。
pharmacology.zhHans: 相关研究很少。一般认为它和近亲氟甲基卡西酮一样，作用于多巴胺、正肾上腺素与血清素的转运体，使这些脑内化学物质的浓度升高。

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. Drugs of its class, the synthetic cathinones, can cause a racing heart, raised blood pressure, overheating, sweating, jaw clenching, insomnia, anxiety, paranoia and a strong urge to keep redosing. Serious risks include heart problems, seizures, psychosis and dependence.
sideEffects.zh: 目前對它在人體的作用所知甚少。與它同類的合成卡西酮類藥物，可能引起心跳急促、血壓升高、體溫過高、大量出汗、咬緊牙關、失眠、焦慮、多疑，以及想一再追加用藥的強烈衝動。嚴重風險包括心臟問題、癲癇發作、精神病與成癮。
sideEffects.zhHans: 目前对它在人体的作用所知甚少。与它同类的合成卡西酮类药物，可能引起心跳急促、血压升高、体温过高、大量出汗、咬紧牙关、失眠、焦虑、多疑，以及想一再追加用药的强烈冲动。严重风险包括心脏问题、癫痫发作、精神病与成瘾。

fact.en: Cathinones take their name from cathine, a stimulant found in the leaves of the khat shrub, Catha edulis. 4-FEC differs from flephedrone only by having an ethyl group instead of a methyl group on its nitrogen.
fact.zh: 卡西酮類的名稱來自卡西因（cathine），這是一種存在於阿拉伯茶（Catha edulis）葉片中的興奮性成分。4-FEC與氟甲基卡西酮（flephedrone）的差別，只在於氮原子上接的是乙基而不是甲基。
fact.zhHans: 卡西酮类的名称来自卡西因（cathine），这是一种存在于阿拉伯茶（Catha edulis）叶片中的兴奋性成分。4-FEC与氟甲基卡西酮（flephedrone）的差别，只在于氮原子上接的是乙基而不是甲基。
